component.name: Death by MPV
component.summary: A video player built on mpv

description.p: A video player whose interface is the reason it exists. mpv draws into the player's own OpenGL context rather than a window of its own, so the glass controls refract the actual picture behind them and the ambient border is spread from the frame's own edges.
Open an episode and the rest of its folder becomes the playlist, in watching order, with how far into each file you got.
